goal: Prevent memory exhaustion and slow block deserialization caused by blocks packed with tiny witness elements
Reject oversized or empty transactions upfront during deserialization instead of buffering them in memory
agreement: Broad support for fixing witness memory amplification (furszy, 0xB10C, instagibbs, fanquake, l0rinc)
Contested objection: encapsulation and API refactoring should precede internal layout changes (purpleKarrot)
Unaddressed objection: script validation allocates more heap memory and runs slower for unknown witness versions (fametrano)
Several reviewers suggest splitting the PR into smaller PRs or deferring the final commit (alexanderwiederin, ajtowns, l0rinc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it removes a network DoS vector where peers send witness-heavy messages that exhaust node memory
Drops transactions exceeding block weight or missing inputs/outputs directly during deserialization

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it eliminates a block validation memory exhaustion vector scheduled as an important fix for v33
Reduces peak memory for worst-case blocks from 182 MiB to 8 MiB and cuts deserialization time by 15x
